views.name: v_deposit_balances
views.definition:
SELECT c.id AS contract_id,
    (COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (p.kind = ANY (ARRAY['deposit_receipt'::text, 'deposit_offset_reversal'::text])) THEN p.amount
            ELSE (- p.amount)
        END), (0)::numeric))::numeric(16,0) AS held,
    (COALESCE(sum(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE (p.kind = 'deposit_receipt'::text)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(16,0) AS received,
    (COALESCE(sum(p.amount) FILTER (WHERE (p.kind = 'deposit_refund'::text)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(16,0) AS refunded,
    (COALESCE(sum(
        CASE
            WHEN (p.kind = 'deposit_offset'::text) THEN p.amount
            WHEN (p.kind = 'deposit_offset_reversal'::text) THEN (- p.amount)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END), (0)::numeric))::numeric(16,0) AS offset_amount
   FROM (smartrent.contracts c
     LEFT JOIN smartrent.payments p ON (((p.contract_id = c.id) AND (p.kind ~~ 'deposit_%'::text) AND (p.status = 'confirmed'::text))))
  GROUP BY c.id;

views.name: v_invoice_balances
views.definition:
SELECT i.id,
    i.contract_id,
    i.status,
    i.total_amount,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN ((i.status = 'issued'::text) AND (i.adjusts_invoice_id IS NULL)) THEN (i.total_amount + COALESCE(adj.amount, (0)::numeric))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END)::numeric(16,0) AS receivable_amount,
    (COALESCE(paid.amount, (0)::numeric))::numeric(16,0) AS paid_amount,
    ((
        CASE
            WHEN ((i.status = 'issued'::text) AND (i.adjusts_invoice_id IS NULL)) THEN (i.total_amount + COALESCE(adj.amount, (0)::numeric))
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END - COALESCE(paid.amount, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(16,0) AS outstanding_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN ((i.status <> 'issued'::text) OR (i.adjusts_invoice_id IS NOT NULL)) THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(paid.amount, (0)::numeric) >= (i.total_amount + COALESCE(adj.amount, (0)::numeric))) THEN 'paid'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(paid.amount, (0)::numeric) = (0)::numeric) THEN 'unpaid'::text
            ELSE 'partial'::text
        END AS payment_status,
    ((i.status = 'issued'::text) AND (i.adjusts_invoice_id IS NULL) AND (i.due_on < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'::text))::date) AND ((i.total_amount + COALESCE(adj.amount, (0)::numeric)) > COALESCE(paid.amount, (0)::numeric))) AS is_overdue
   FROM ((smartrent.invoices i
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum(invoices.total_amount) AS amount
           FROM smartrent.invoices
          WHERE ((invoices.adjusts_invoice_id = i.id) AND (invoices.status = 'issued'::text))) adj ON (true))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT sum((((a.value ->> 'amount'::text))::numeric * (
                CASE
                    WHEN (p.kind = ANY (ARRAY['receipt_reversal'::text, 'deposit_offset_reversal'::text])) THEN '-1'::integer
                    ELSE 1
                END)::numeric)) AS amount
           FROM (smartrent.payments p
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(p.allocations) a(value))
          WHERE ((p.status = 'confirmed'::text) AND ((a.value ->> 'invoiceId'::text) = (i.id)::text))) paid ON (true));

views.name: v_public_rooms
views.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.property_id,
    r.code,
    r.name,
    r.area_m2,
    r.capacity,
    r.room_type_code,
    r.room_type_name,
    r.listing_slug,
    r.listing_title,
    r.listing_description,
    r.video_url,
    r.rules_text,
    r.required_deposit,
    r.amenities,
    r.rates,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(x.value) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (jsonb_array_elements(r.images) x(value)
             JOIN smartrent.files f ON ((f.id = ((x.value ->> 'fileId'::text))::uuid)))
          WHERE ((f.visibility = 'public'::text) AND (f.scan_status = 'clean'::text))), '[]'::jsonb) AS images
   FROM (smartrent.rooms r
     JOIN smartrent.properties p ON ((p.id = r.property_id)))
  WHERE ((r.listing_status = 'published'::text) AND p.is_active AND (r.operating_status <> 'inactive'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM (jsonb_array_elements(r.images) x(value)
             JOIN smartrent.files f ON ((f.id = ((x.value ->> 'fileId'::text))::uuid)))
          WHERE ((f.visibility = 'public'::text) AND (f.scan_status = 'clean'::text)))));

views.name: v_room_occupancy
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    property_id,
    code,
    name,
    floor_label,
    area_m2,
    capacity,
    room_type_code,
    room_type_name,
    description,
    rules_text,
    required_deposit,
    operating_status,
    status_reason,
    listing_slug,
    listing_title,
    listing_description,
    listing_status,
    video_url,
    published_at,
    amenities,
    images,
    rates,
    status_history,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM smartrent.contracts c
              WHERE ((c.room_id = r.id) AND (c.status = 'active'::text)))) THEN 'occupied'::text
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM smartrent.bookings b
              WHERE ((b.room_id = r.id) AND (b.hold_status = 'holding'::text) AND (b.hold_expires_at > now())))) THEN 'reserved'::text
            ELSE operating_status
        END AS occupancy_status
   FROM smartrent.rooms r;

SELECT id,
    code,
    room_id,
    user_id,
    status,
    starts_on,
    ends_on,
    move_in_on,
    move_out_on,
    (user_id = smartrent.request_user_id()) AS finance_visible
   FROM smartrent.contracts c
  WHERE ((user_id = smartrent.request_user_id()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.occupants) p(value)
          WHERE (((p.value ->> 'userId'::text) = (smartrent.request_user_id())::text) AND ((p.value ->> 'leftOn'::text) IS NULL)))));

views.name: v_user_invoices
views.definition:
SELECT i.id,
    i.code,
    i.contract_id,
    i.period_id,
    i.kind,
    i.adjusts_invoice_id,
    i.metered_only,
    i.status,
    i.service_from,
    i.service_to,
    i.electricity_start,
    i.electricity_end,
    i.electricity_from_at,
    i.electricity_to_at,
    i.water_start,
    i.water_end,
    i.water_from_at,
    i.water_to_at,
    i.readings_history,
    i.correction_reason,
    i.lines,
    i.total_amount,
    i.customer_snapshot,
    i.issued_on,
    i.due_on,
    i.issued_by,
    i.issued_at,
    i.voided_at,
    i.void_reason,
    i.notes,
    i.idempotency_key,
    i.request_hash,
    i.created_at,
    b.receivable_amount,
    b.paid_amount,
    b.outstanding_amount,
    b.payment_status,
    b.is_overdue
   FROM ((smartrent.invoices i
     JOIN smartrent.v_invoice_balances b ON ((b.id = i.id)))
     JOIN smartrent.contracts c ON ((c.id = i.contract_id)))
  WHERE ((c.user_id = smartrent.request_user_id()) AND (i.status <> 'draft'::text));

views.name: v_user_notifications
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    recipient_id,

views.name: v_user_tickets
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    code,
    room_id,
    contract_id,
    reported_by,
    category_code,
    title,
    description,
    priority,
    status,
    due_at,
    resolution_notes,
    attachment_file_ids,
    COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(m.value ORDER BY (m.value ->> 'createdAt'::text)) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM jsonb_array_elements(t.messages) m(value)
          WHERE (NOT COALESCE(((m.value ->> 'isInternal'::text))::boolean, false))), '[]'::jsonb) AS messages,
    history,
    created_at,
    updated_at
   FROM smartrent.tickets t
  WHERE ((reported_by = smartrent.request_user_id()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM smartrent.contracts c
          WHERE ((c.id = t.contract_id) AND (c.user_id = smartrent.request_user_id())))));
